relationships.subject: naringenin
relationships.evidence_quote: The binding energy between TP53 and MOL004328 (naringenin) was <−9.6 kcal/mol, the binding energy between VEGFA and MOL004328 (naringenin) was <−7.5 kcal/mol, and the binding energy between MMP9 and MOL004328 (naringenin) was <−9 kcal/mol.

relationships.subject: HIF-1
relationships.evidence_quote: HIF-1, which has been extensively studied, can regulate downstream VEGF, erythropoietin (EPO), and heat shock protein gene expression

key_findings: Network pharmacology and docking identify VEGFA, MMP9, TP53 and TNF as core targets of Huoxiang Drink against IBS, with HIF and TNF pathways enriched.
